<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Dismissal" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Dismissal">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal" name="Dismissal" sourceRef="Participant_MPON" targetRef="StartEvent_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="MPOO Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Dismissal" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Received_to_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Received_to_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_to_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Split" name="Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_to_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision_to_Oppose</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision_to_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Oppose" name="Oppose dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision_to_Oppose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Oppose_to_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm" name="Confirm dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision_to_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm_to_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Opposed" name="Dismissal opposed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Oppose_to_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Confirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm_to_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Received_to_Review" sourceRef="StartEvent_Dismissal" targetRef="Task_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_to_Decision" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_to_Oppose" name="Opposes" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Oppose"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_to_Confirm" name="Confirms" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Oppose_to_End" sourceRef="Task_Oppose" targetRef="EndEvent_Opposed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_to_End" sourceRef="Task_Confirm" targetRef="EndEvent_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
